relocation_strict.reason: All 17 relocation-bearing instructions retain equal offsets, types, targets, and zero addends, but code bytes are below 100%; strict match is therefore not claimable.

baseline.improvement: Casting only the nonzero test to signed int changes the generated zero comparison from cmplwi to retail's cmpwi.

divergence: The recovered control flow and 436-byte object size are exact. The remaining instruction mismatches are nonvolatile-register allocation: retail assigns slot_index/mode to r24/r25, scratch/header to r29, parent to r30, count to r27, data index/read size to r26, source data to r28, and loop/data pointers across r21-r23/r31; canonical GC/1.3 assigns those live ranges to different registers.
